name: 论语
author: 孔子及其弟子
core: 以语录体记录孔子论仁、礼、学、政的言行，奠定儒家伦理与教育的基调。
coreEn: A dialogue-style record of Confucius on ren, li, learning and government, setting the tone of Ruist ethics and education.
influence: 东亚两千余年科举、家规与士人精神的根本文本。
influenceEn: The foundational text behind two millennia of East Asian exam culture, family norms and scholar ethos.

name: 道德经
author: 老子
core: 以「道」为万物本源，主张无为、守柔、反者道之动，是道家最精微的纲要。
coreEn: Takes Dao as the source of all; teaches wuwei, softness and reversal as the movement of Dao — the succinct core of Daoism.
influence: 深刻影响中医、兵法、书法与东亚审美与政治智慧。
influenceEn: Deeply shaped Chinese medicine, strategy, calligraphy and East Asian aesthetics and statecraft.

name: 理想国
author: 柏拉图
core: 借苏格拉底之口探讨正义，以理型论与洞穴寓言勾勒理想政制与灵魂秩序。
coreEn: Through Socrates, it probes justice via the Theory of Forms and the cave allegory, sketching an ideal polity and soul.
influence: 西方政治哲学与认识论的源头之一，至今争论不休。
influenceEn: A fountainhead of Western political philosophy and epistemology, still debated.

name: 沉思录
author: 马可·奥勒留
core: 一位皇帝写给自己的修行笔记，以控制二分与顺应自然安顿乱世中的内心。
coreEn: A emperor's private notebook: the dichotomy of control and living by nature to steady the mind amid turmoil.
influence: 斯多葛实践最亲切的入口，现代认知行为疗法的前声。
influenceEn: The gentlest entry to Stoic practice, and a precursor to modern CBT.

name: 纯粹理性批判
author: 康德
core: 追问「先天综合判断如何可能」，划定理性疆界：知识限于现象，物自体不可知。
coreEn: Asks how synthetic a priori judgments are possible, drawing reason's bounds: knowledge stays within phenomena; noumena are unknowable.
influence: 开启德国古典哲学，被视为现代认识论的转折点。
influenceEn: Launched German idealism and is seen as a turning point in modern epistemology.

name: 存在与时间
author: 海德格尔
core: 以「此在（Dasein）」重提「存在」之问，分析操心、向死存在与本真生存。
coreEn: Reopens the question of Being via Dasein, analyzing care, being-toward-death and authentic existence.
influence: 现象学通向存在主义的桥梁，重塑当代人文学。
influenceEn: A bridge from phenomenology to existentialism, reshaping the humanities.

name: 查拉图斯特拉如是说
author: 尼采
core: 以诗体宣示「上帝已死」、超人与永恒轮回，呼唤人自我超越。
coreEn: In poetic guise declares 'God is dead', the Übermensch and eternal recurrence, calling humans to self-overcoming.
influence: 深刻影响存在主义、心理学与 20 世纪文化。
influenceEn: Deeply influenced existentialism, psychology and 20th-century culture.

name: 尼各马可伦理学
author: 亚里士多德
core: 以「幸福（eudaimonia）」为目标，主张德性在于中道，靠习惯与实践智慧养成。
coreEn: Aims at eudaimonia; virtue lies in the mean, cultivated by habit and practical wisdom.
influence: 德性伦理的奠基作，当代应用伦理学的重要资源。
influenceEn: Foundational for virtue ethics and a key resource in applied ethics today.

name: 传习录
author: 王守仁（王阳明）
core: 阐发「知行合一」与「致良知」，主张心即理，把儒家践履拉回当下本心。
coreEn: Expounds the unity of knowledge and action and 'extending innate knowing', holding that principle is in the mind.
influence: 阳明学东传日韩，影响东亚近世思想与行动伦理。
influenceEn: Spread to Japan and Korea, shaping early-modern East Asian thought and activist ethics.

name: 人性论
author: 休谟
core: 以经验主义重构人性：观念源于印象，因果只是恒常联结，自我是一束知觉。
coreEn: Reconstructs human nature empirically: ideas trace to impressions, causation is constant conjunction, the self a bundle of perceptions.
influence: 经验主义高峰，直接启发康德「唤醒」与当代心智哲学。
influenceEn: The high point of empiricism, awakening Kant and inspiring philosophy of mind today.

name: 第二性
author: 西蒙娜·德·波伏瓦
core: 以「女人不是天生的，而是被塑造成的」揭示性别的社会建构与他者化。
coreEn: 'One is not born, but rather becomes, a woman' — unveils gender as social construction and the making of the Other.
influence: 女性主义理论的奠基文本，深刻改变 20 世纪社会想象。
influenceEn: A foundational text of feminist theory that reshaped 20th-century social imagination.

name: 正义论
author: 约翰·罗尔斯
core: 以「原初状态的无知之幕」推导公平原则：平等自由优先，差异原则调节不平等。
coreEn: From the 'original position' behind a veil of ignorance derives fair principles: equal liberty first, inequality governed by the difference principle.
influence: 重启规范政治哲学，成为现代福利与宪政讨论的基准框架。
influenceEn: Revived normative political philosophy and became the benchmark for welfare and constitutional debate.

name: 道德形而上学的奠基
nameEn: Groundwork of the Metaphysics of Morals
author: 伊曼努尔·康德
core: 将道德建立在理性自身的绝对命令之上：只按你同时愿意它成为普遍法则的准则去行动。
coreEn: Grounds morality in reason's own categorical imperative: act only on maxims you could will as universal law.
influence: 义务论伦理学的奠基之作，至今仍主宰着关于道德与尊严的讨论。
influenceEn: The founding text of deontology, still shaping debates on duty and human dignity.

name: 伦理学
author: 斯宾诺莎
core: 以几何学方法论证神即自然，情感与自由都源于对必然性的理解。
coreEn: Proves God-or-Nature by geometric method; emotion and freedom follow from understanding necessity.
influence: 启发了后世的一元论、决定论与对情感机制的研究。
influenceEn: Inspired later monism, determinism and the study of the emotions.

name: 哲学研究
author: 路德维希·维特根斯坦
era: 英国 · 日常语言哲学
core: 意义即语言游戏中的使用，哲学问题多因语言脱离日常用法而生。
coreEn: Meaning is use within language-games; philosophical puzzles arise when language idles beyond everyday use.
influence: 重塑了分析哲学对语言、心灵与意义的理解。
influenceEn: Reshaped analytic philosophy's grasp of language, mind and meaning.

name: 存在与虚无
author: 让-保罗·萨特
core: 人是被判定为自由的：存在先于本质，我们必须在无依据中为自己选择。
coreEn: Humans are condemned to be free: existence precedes essence, and we must choose without foundation.
influence: 存在主义的系统巨著，塑造了二十世纪关于自由与责任的思潮。
influenceEn: The systematic masterwork of existentialism, shaping twentieth-century thought on freedom and responsibility.
